_doc: Corrections applied on top of the Wikidata export (tools/raw/wikidata_highpoints.json). Convention: highest point of the main territory, consistent with the mledoze areas (e.g. Australia without Heard Island, Netherlands without the Caribbean islands, Denmark without Greenland). Sources: CIA World Factbook / national survey values.

AUS.name: mont Kosciuszko
AUS.reason: Wikidata gives Mawson Peak (Heard Island, external territory)

NLD.name: Vaalserberg
NLD.reason: Wikidata gives Mount Scenery (Saba, Caribbean Netherlands)

CHN.name: Everest
CHN.reason: 2020 joint survey 8848.86 m; Wikidata max picks an outdated 8850

FRA.name: mont Blanc
FRA.reason: 2021 survey 4805.59 m; Wikidata lists several yearly surveys

GMB.name: point non nommé
GMB.reason: missing on Wikidata; CIA Factbook 'unnamed elevation 53 m'

SEN.name: point non nommé près de Nepen Diakha
SEN.reason: CIA Factbook value; Wikidata gives a lower cliff

SWE.name: Kebnekaise
SWE.reason: southern glacier peak melted below the northern rock peak (2096.8 m)

IRN.name: mont Damavand
IRN.reason: commonly accepted value; Wikidata max picks 5628
